summary: Two bulletins (Oct 4 and Sep 27) and the website agree: Sunday 9 AM English and 11 AM Spanish Masses, a Monday 6 PM Holy Hour and a Wednesday 6 PM Adoration with 6:30 PM Mass in the basement chapel. Both bulletins cancel individual evening events (Monday Oct 5 and 12, Wednesday Oct 7, Saturday Oct 10, for Fr. Brendan's retreat), recorded as dated cancellations. One question: whether the hedged Saturday 12-1 PM Holy Hour and Confession is a regular weekly slot. The Wednesday 7-8 PM Confession is at Holy Cross, DeWitt (another parish) and is left out.

slots.rationale:
R30: every Saturday source hedges. The cover box says 'Check Social Media for Saturday Option: Saturday 12pm & by appointment', and the website says 'Saturdays Reconciliation is offered during a Holy Hour 12-1pm. *This is subject to change due to Funerals/Parish Commitments*'. The dated 12-1pm line is printed (Oct 3, Sep 27 bulletin) and struck through for Oct 10 (newest). Leaning to include it weekly, since the cover and the website both give it as the Saturday schedule; the end time is from the calendar line and the website. This slot is the Confession; its time is the Holy Hour's (POLICY, Times).

Delegated review (owner authorized best judgment on 2026-10-22): Accept the explicitly conditional Saturday Confession pattern with the bulletin/social-media and funerals/parish-commitments caveats visible. Preserve the separately settled October 10 cancellation; do not imply every future Saturday is assured.
